items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability leading to unauthenticated customer account takeover and privilege escalation
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability allows unauthenticated remote attackers to switch customer sessions to other accounts and escalate privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and application denial-of-service.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity stored XSS vulnerability could result in arbitrary code execution and requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability (Adobe Commerce B2B)
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability could enable a security-feature bypass and requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity stored XSS vulnerability could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Unauthenticated arbitrary file upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Improper Input Validation leading to security feature bypass
items.summary: A critical improper input validation vulnerability allows for security feature bypass, and Adobe is aware of it being exploited in the wild.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP object injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: An unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer allows remote code execution via a crafted cookie without authentication or admin session.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability (Auth Bypass)
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access to the application.
